name: Icha Pri! ~Ojou-sama to Icha Love Ecchi na Mainichi~
original_name: いちゃぷり！ ～お嬢様とイチャラブえっちな毎日～
source:
Masaki was told by his grandfather that he must marry one of the Tenjouin sisters who are also his cousins: tsundere Yuzuna, tennen Sakura or pettanko Koyuri. And there’s also a maid who’s his osananajimi, a brocon imouto and a loli nurse.

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/12/03/december-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
正树的祖父告诉他，他必须嫁给一位天城院姐妹，她们也是他的堂兄弟：傲慢柚奈、天年樱或小百合。还有他的御侍女仆、野马妹妹和萝莉护士。

[编辑自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/12/03/december-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
